fusion.protocol: Midrank ECDF, seven dimensions, constant dimensions abstain; empirical calibration, not FPR control

model.architecture: Attribute trigram KNN + masked relational process encoder KNN + causal-history MLP
model.limitation: Adaptation, not a paper reproduction; process maximum over variable windows is not an FPR guarantee; pre-campaign normality assumed

protocol: Same-host overlapping development windows; no attack-label threshold tuning. Rules remain default unless new results justify replacement.

verification.limitation: Checks internal event/route consistency, not log authenticity, model optimality or ground-truth correctness.
